sql: SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Khamis Mushait' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-09-30' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03')
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Ghamdi Logistics'

SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY avg_units DESC, c.segment LIMIT 1)

SELECT m FROM (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS m, CAST(COUNT(rt.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) AS ratio FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY m) ORDER BY ratio DESC, m LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-06' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) NOT BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 IS NOT NULL AND h24 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(h25,0) - h24) / h24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-06' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 > 0 ORDER BY (h25 - h24) * 1.0 / h24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('10', '11', '12') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) rf ON rf.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(rev.r, 0) - COALESCE(ref.f, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) rev ON rev.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS f FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) ref ON ref.eid = e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r24, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 IS NOT NULL AND r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id IS NOT NULL AND oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 > 0 AND h25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (h25 - h24) / h24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_res AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), cust_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_res cr JOIN cust_orders co ON co.customer_id = cr.customer_id WHERE cr.avg_h > (SELECT avg_h FROM overall) AND co.n >= 8
